def transform(grid):
    g=tuple(map(tuple,grid))
    d=colorobjs(g)
    allsh={}
    for c,v in d.items():
        for ob in v: allsh.setdefault(nsh(ob),[]).append((c,ob))
    best=None
    for sh,lst in allsh.items():
        if len({c for c,_ in lst})>1 and (best is None or len(sh)>best[0]):
            best=(len(sh),lst)
    tgt=min(c for c,v in d.items() if len(v)==1)
    ul_t,lr_t=ulcorner(d[tgt][0]),lrcorner(d[tgt][0])
    def gap(ob):
        ul,lr=ulcorner(ob),lrcorner(ob)
        dr=max(0, max(ul_t[0]-lr[0]-1, ul[0]-lr_t[0]-1))
        dc=max(0, max(ul_t[1]-lr[1]-1, ul[1]-lr_t[1]-1))
        return dr+dc
    src=max(best[1],key=lambda t:gap(t[1]))[1]
    out=[list(r) for r in grid]
    for i,j in toindices(src): out[i][j]=tgt
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(name, transform(G[name+' input'])==G[name+' output'])
out=transform(G['Test input'])
# what changed vs test input
diffs=[(i,j,G['Test input'][i][j],out[i][j]) for i in range(len(out)) for j in range(len(out[0])) if out[i][j]!=G['Test input'][i][j]]
print(diffs)

prog = '''def transform(grid):
    """Recolor exactly one object: find same-shape, same-orientation twin objects
    (normalized index sets equal, no rotation). If exactly one twin lies fully
    inside the bounding-box backdrop of a singleton-color object (a color with
    exactly one object), recolor the OTHER twin to that singleton's color."""
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]

    # segment objects (4-connectivity)
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    ents=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if not seen[i][j]:
                col=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                seen[i][j]=True
                while stack:
                    r,c=stack.pop(); cells.append((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not seen[nr][nc] and g[nr][nc]==col:
                            seen[nr][nc]=True; stack.append((nr,nc))
                ents.append((col,frozenset(cells)))
    color_count={}
    for c,s in ents: color_count[c]=color_count.get(c,0)+1
    singles=[s for c,s in ents if color_count[c]==1]

    def backdrop(s):
        rs=[r for r,_ in s]; cs=[c for _,c in s]
        return frozenset((r,c) for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1) for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1))
    def normset(s):
        mr=min(r for r,_ in s); mc=min(c for _,c in s)
        return frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in s)

    for a in range(len(ents)):
        for b in range(a+1,len(ents)):
            ca,sa=ents[a]; cb,sb=ents[b]
            if normset(sa)!=normset(sb): continue
            qa=[s for s in singles if normset(sa)<=normset(s) and sa!=s]
            qb=[s for s in singles if normset(sb)<=normset(s) and sb!=s]
            if len(qa)+len(qb)==1:
                if qa: tc,ts=ca,sb
                else:  tc,ts=cb,sa
                sc,ss=qa[0] if (qa or qb) else (None,None)
                tgt=qa[0][0] if qa else qb[0][0]
                return [[tgt if (r,c) in ts else g[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    return g
'''
